title: The Average Tax Refund Was $3,276. Is That Good?
description: IRS filing season data through May 8, 2026 shows an average refund of $3,276, about $273 a month across a year. Much of a refund is often extra tax withheld from your own paychecks; your situation and credits vary. Educational only, not financial advice. #taxrefund #personalfinance #shorts

title: HP Started With $538 in a Garage
description: Bill Hewlett and Dave Packard started HP in a Palo Alto garage with $538 in cash and a used drill press, and a coin toss decided the company name in 1939. One early big order: eight audio oscillators for Disney's Fantasia. #hewlettpackard #entrepreneur #shorts
